QuestInfo.name: Oh, the Aches
QuestInfo.0: Corba, Leafre's sage, was so old that no one dared to guess his age. But something was troubling him lately...
QuestInfo.1: Corba is in pain from his knee. He thinks making bone soup is the best for such pains and has requested that you get #r#t4033794##k for him. Again he wants this done in secret because he got appearances to maintain.
QuestInfo.2: You got #t4033794# for Corba so that he can make bone soup to ease his pains.

0.0: I'm going to make a mighty cloak with the Harp Feathers you brought me. But... Warm clothing will be of no use if I'm frozen in place... They say the cartilage is the first thing to go, and my knees agree!
0.1: Ouch. My back aches. My knees ache. My shoulders ache. I need broth! With broth, I can hike to Wyvern Valley, and nobody will laugh at me. Will you help?

yes.0: Kentaurus's Skull is great for broth. I need #r30 #t4033794##k items to last me one month. Please don't tell anyone you're helping me.

no.0: You will be punished for being mean to old people

yes.0: You've done well this time as well. Swing by next time to have some broth.

item.0: Kentauruses roam around in #b#MDmirrorD_321_1_##k. Remember! #rThirty #t4033794##k items is what I need!
